evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds

observations.why: The contract is framed around reliability and predictable return — security of process and mastery of a dependable mechanism.
The appeal is to safety and preservation of effort — no work is destroyed even under failure, a conservation value.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: The design offers the agent self-directed choice of retrieval cadence while preserving reliable delivery — autonomy paired with conservation.
